notes.title: Update Notes for 6/28/25
notes.content:
Added a new skill called Think to the Inquisitor skilltree.

 Balanced some weapons and enemies.

 Changed Attack, M.Attack, and M.Defense to Strength, Intellect, and Resist.

 Fixed cases where the wrong abbreviations were used in item and skill descriptions.
 
 Added ancient tablet requirement to building a special sword.

notes.title: Update Notes for 6/17/25
notes.content:
Fixed Law to a Chaotic Land quest failing during endgame.
 
 Fixed magical flute not operating as intended (hopefully for the last time!).
 
 Fixed a few misinformed messages.
 
 Fixed incorrect shop chests in a late game town.

notes.title: Update Notes for 6/16/25
notes.content:
Fixed Book Return quest exploit.
 
 Fixed false turn-in information for Culling Centaurs quest.
 
 Fixed Fill and Rupp's event looping if interacted with again.
 
 Fixed a skeletal pirate not detecting the player.
 
 Fixed magical flute not operating as intended.
 
 Fixed bandit queen not spawning.

notes.title: Update Notes for 6/14/25
notes.content:
Fixed circus stabber bounty not updating properly.
  
 Fixed getting stuck in the fishing contest.
 
 Fixed fishing spot not resetting in chapter 3.

notes.title: Update Notes for 6/12/25
notes.content:
Fixed chests and doors in the depths not opening correctly.

 Updated skill tree menu to bypass character selection since only Crusaderman can utilize it.

notes.title: Update Notes for 6/11/25
notes.content: [p] Fixed a bug that broke the ability to fish when entering the sea cave in the southeast. (For those who are already affected by the bug; teleporting away, or revisiting the cave and leaving should fix it.) [/p][p] Fixed a typo in a skill description.[/p][p] Fixed being locked in the "convention" room.[/p]

notes.title: Update Notes for 6/8/25
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented a denizen of the volcano from going away.

 Fixed a certain boar that didn't want to go away and added a retroactive fix for those who left boar island prematurely. (won't work if the quest is already failed.)

 Updated the randomized options for a certain hidden skill.

notes.title: Update Notes for 6/7/25
notes.content:
Fixed soft lock in a certain castle that requires you to make a dire choice.
 Fixed a bug that prevents quest completion if you leave boar island too early.
 Fixed a couple incorrect dialogues during candidate quest.
 Fixed a requirement for a food delivery that required the wrong amounts.

 Added color to the fight option.

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/27/25
notes.content: Fixed a soft lock during a certain companion's quest.

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/19/25
notes.content:
Fixed soft locks in the tower.
Fixed broken checks in the desert.

I appreciate the reports and apologize for the delay in fixing them.

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/17/25
notes.content: Fixed certain skills not working correctly on controller.

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/15/25
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1

 Improved tutorial by adding explanations for the journal and skill trees.

 Minor bug fixes.
